skill_name: Write an essay that argues whether a belief in fate is a hindrance or a help.
workflow: Belief in fate can be a double-edged sword. On the one hand, it serves as a source of comfort and assurance. People who believe in fate often have a greater sense of perspective and recognition that everything happens for a reason. This can help people cope with difficult problems that may arise in life, since believing in fate can give them a sense of peace and hope that they are in their current path for a reason.
